command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$ns=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_04/nodes'; foreach(`$x in `$ns){ `$ua='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_04/nodes/'+`$x.node_id+'/command?cmd=display%20current-configuration'; `$ub='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork-for-perf_04/nodes/'+`$x.node_id+'/command?cmd=display%20current-configuration'; `$a=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$ua).output; `$b=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$ub).output; `$al=`$a -split '\r?\n' | Where-Object { `$_ -notmatch '^!Last configuration' }; `$bl=`$b -split '\r?\n' | Where-Object { `$_ -notmatch '^!Last configuration' }; `$d=Compare-Object `$bl `$al; if(`$d){ Write-Output ('===== '+`$x.node_id+' ====='); `$d | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String | Write-Output } }"
